selection.rule: sum(cost) <= 3 and count <= 4 + extra_slots; incompatible pairs excluded; perks blocked on a save's first run
selection.mid_run_changes: addictions cure after 20 clean days; blackmail ends on refusal/capture; the hypertech smuggler's mind reprogrammer can add a non-negative mind_editable perk or remove any mind_editable perk (charge |cost|, cooldown 5 days per point)

reputation_rules.unlock: positive perk active while rep >= threshold; negative while rep <= threshold; re-evaluated on every change (perks relock)

perks.name: Agoraphobia
perks.effect: After any after-hours outing you must stay in for 2 nights: one outing every third night at most.
perks.strategy: Cuts dumping-ground and commissary trips to a third. Harmless to shop-only and production runs; crippling for scavenging lines.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Alcohol Addiction
perks.effect: Withdrawal from day 1 (counter starts at 3): every counter trade is 8 % worse (pay 8 % more, receive 8 % less) until you drink or 20 sober days cure it (perk removed).
perks.strategy: Choice: go cold turkey (≈17 days of −8 % on every trade, then free) or keep a supply (each dose resets the cure clock). Cold turkey is usually right early; stacking two addictions doubles the hit.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Vigilant
perks.effect: Night burglary never happens: the uninsured break-in roll is skipped entirely.
perks.strategy: Insurance becomes pure waste; drop it and bank (net worth/400 + 3) a night. Big for stock-heavy runs.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Ascetic
perks.effect: Main stock grid shrinks from 24x10 to 16x10 (−33 %).
perks.strategy: Forces fast turnover and small machines; production footprints and stockpiling for market events suffer badly. 4 points back.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Aug Menace
perks.effect: Augs start on day 1 (shotgun and aug guide given, first aug in 2-4 days), never end (no all-clear), and aug presence >= 100 is game over on every difficulty. Aug kill cash ×1.25.
perks.strategy: Adds a permanent identify-and-shoot task from day 1. Every aug that leaves raises presence; kills lower it. Profitable only for a policy that reads tells well.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Awful Negotiator
perks.effect: Bargain panel is never offered, and every counter trade gets a permanent 5 % penalty (pay 5 % more buying, receive 5 % less selling).
perks.strategy: Removes the whole haggling action family. Policy must win on sourcing, markup setting and production instead. 3 points back.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Bad Lease
perks.effect: Starting rent +40; it compounds with every landlord increase.
perks.strategy: ≈ +40-60 a week for the run (≈ +500 over ten weeks on normal). Cheap point for engines that clear rent easily.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Banned from the Commissary
perks.effect: Commissary never opens, food stamps are never introduced (no stamp guide, no stamp sellers, no stamps from the exchange).
perks.strategy: Deletes the stamp inspection trade and commissary purchases. Small cost for production lines, real cost for the Honest Broker.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Blabbermouth
perks.effect: Every committed crime ×1.33; rep gains with Black Market and Revolution halved.
perks.strategy: Shrinks the crime budget by a quarter and slows BM/REV perks. Honest runs barely feel it (2 points back); fence/cook runs should not take it.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Blackmail
perks.effect: A blackmailer visits on day 1 and every day with day%7==1 demanding 40 + day credits. Refusing (or having him arrested: he is stealth-wanted, reward 150) costs −30 rep (scaled by the difficulty loss multiplier) with Lower Levels, Revolution, Security and Upper Levels, then the perk is gone.
perks.strategy: Pay-or-refuse decision. Refusing on day 1 trades ≈1300 credits of fees for −30 rep (LL Poor Reviews and SEC Watchlist at once) while rep is cheapest to rebuild; arresting him instead also pays the 150 bounty.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Careful Scavenger
perks.effect: Dumping ground: 2 fewer search attempts (3 instead of 5) but zero wound chance.
perks.strategy: Trades 40 % of finds for never being wounded (no lost outings). With Proficient Scavenger: 5 safe attempts.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Colorful Character
perks.effect: +3 perk slots (max 7 perks); does nothing in play.
perks.strategy: Only lets a loadout stack more negatives for points. Its presence is a signal that the loadout is wide.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Convict
perks.effect: Security −30 at start (raw, unscaled). Report, capture and aug-kill rewards (cash and the Security rep they give) ×0.75.
perks.strategy: Starts at SEC Watchlist (evidence ×1.2); −10 more is Alarm Ignored. With the Fence start (SEC −30 × loss multiplier) Security sits at −60 or worse: Most Wanted from day 1.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Degenerative Osteoarthritis
perks.effect: Search attempts drop by 1 each week after the first (5,4,3, then none once below 3 — from day 22). Start with 2 bandages.
perks.strategy: Scavenging is a 3-week asset. With Proficient Scavenger it lasts to day 35.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Diplomatic
perks.effect: Trade-generated rep ×1.33 (positive gains only).
perks.strategy: Reaches every positive rep perk a third sooner. Strong for perk-driven paths (Security 80/100 budgets and no inspections, UL Tips, LL Referral).
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Gambling Addiction
perks.effect: Lottery unlocked from day 1 (normally after day 14); start with a scratcher and the gambler's coin (+5 luck while carried). When a seller offers lottery tickets/scratchers you are forced to buy some (first one whenever affordable, more with falling odds).
perks.strategy: Gives a point AND +5 luck (5 % inspection-save chance). Forced buys are small. With Lucky: 20 % luck.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Handy
perks.effect: Start with a shabby toolbox (4 slots) holding shabby screwdriver, wire cutter, crowbar and welder.
perks.strategy: Tools expose hidden item features in barter, open tool-gated dumping-ground extras and clear Hoarder's tool pile. Cheap kit for appraisal and scavenging lines.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Hoarder
perks.effect: Three immovable debris piles along the bottom of the stock grid. One clears after 10 rest nights, one with crowbar/wire cutter/welder (each tool yields loot), one via a paid 50-credit service over 10 nights.
perks.strategy: Temporary capacity loss with a small salvage payoff. Free (cost 0); pairs with Handy.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Illiterate
perks.effect: No guide/manual can be read.
perks.strategy: Major for a human, minor for our agent: the strategist injects the rules regardless. Check that the bridge does not gate knowledge on reading a guide.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Intimidating
perks.effect: Every committed crime ×0.67.
perks.strategy: Widens the crime budget by half: slower evidence, later inspections and sentencing. The defining perk for fence/cook runs.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Known Snitch
perks.effect: Wanted-poster customers never visit (no wanted list, no random wanted client); Revolution and Black Market −10 at start.
perks.strategy: Removes bounty/capture income (100-1500 + Security +5 each) and a Security rep source. Hurts Armourer/Honest Broker; BM −10 cuts BM client chance.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Lucky
perks.effect: Luck +15: 15 % chance an inspection that finds something overlooks everything; 15 % chance to dodge each scavenging wound; better lottery/crate odds.
perks.strategy: A hidden 15 % 'free pass' on every bad inspection changes the contraband calculus. Stack with the gambler's coin for 20 %.
perks.visible: perk VISIBLE; luck value and rolls HIDDEN

perks.name: Maimed
perks.effect: Dumping ground unavailable: no scavenging at all (some story beats that need it are skipped).
perks.strategy: Removes the night scavenging action. 2 points back for runs that never scavenge.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Makeshift Reactor
perks.effect: Off the grid: no power bill, no blackouts, power-hijack upgrades hidden. A reactor powers the store while integrity > 25; it decays ~18/night and must be repaired (scrap +60, junk +30). At 0 it explodes: game over.
perks.strategy: Saves day/10 + 5 a night of power and blackout losses, but adds a must-not-forget maintenance loop with a run-ending failure. Scrap supply is the constraint.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Minimalist
perks.effect: Main stock grid shrinks from 24x10 to 20x10 (−17 %).
perks.strategy: Milder Ascetic. 2 points back; acceptable for counter traders.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Model Citizen
perks.effect: Security +30 at start (raw). Report, capture and aug-kill rewards (cash and Security rep) ×1.5.
perks.strategy: Security Surplus merchant from day 1 (SEC 20) and a fast road to 40/60/80. Gunsmith start (+25 Sec) + this = 55; + Well Connected = 70 (Trusted).
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Narcotic Addiction
perks.effect: Same as Alcohol Addiction but for narcotics (relief items also suppress it). −8 % on every trade while in withdrawal; cured after 20 clean days.
perks.strategy: A Cook can feed it from its own product, but each dose delays the cure.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Nicotine Addiction
perks.effect: Same as Alcohol Addiction but for nicotine. Starts with a counterfeit cigarette.
perks.strategy: Same choice as the other addictions.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Prime Real Estate
perks.effect: +1 normal customer every day (clamp 0-6); starting rent +75 (compounds).
perks.strategy: Worth it once a marginal customer clears ~12-20 credits a day of profit; it also speeds rep from trade. Hard on Rock Bottom's first rent.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Proficient Scavenger
perks.effect: +2 dumping-ground search attempts per outing (7 instead of 5).
perks.strategy: +40 % scavenging yield (and wound exposure). Core for Smelter/Shark.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Public Enemy
perks.effect: −15 rep with every faction at start (raw).
perks.strategy: No perk triggers at −15, but every faction is one bad trade from its −20 perk (LL Poor Reviews, SEC Watchlist); BM below 0 lowers BM client odds. 2 points back.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Revolution Sympathizer
perks.effect: Revolution +25 at start (raw); with REV_REQUEST unlocked, an extra Revolution marketplace request on day%7==1.
perks.strategy: REV Request is live from day 1 (needs the Marketplace Requests upgrade, 250) and REV client chance rises to 6. Quartermaster at 40 is close.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Savings
perks.effect: +150 starting cash.
perks.strategy: One early purchase sooner (Showcase I, Winemaker). Biggest relative effect on Rock Bottom, Gunsmith and Aquafarmer starts.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Sawyer's Crew
perks.effect: Underground Exchange from day 1 (normally day 25 unless Fence start); janitorial service always free (vandalized: day/5 + 30 instead of day/10 + 75).
perks.strategy: Exchange barters from day 1 matter to fence/shark lines; the janitor saving is ~5-13 a night. Redundant exchange on the Fence start.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Secret Admirer
perks.effect: At shutter open, a gift arrives with chance 3 % rising 6 %/day after 3 dry days (certain by 12): mostly cheap goods, sometimes bandages, a black injector if addicted, one Immunivax if Sentinel.
perks.strategy: Roughly a small free item a week; the Sentinel/addiction gifts are its real value.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Sentinel Collapse Disorder
perks.effect: Must inject Immunivax weekly: from 6 days late warnings, from 7 days damage accumulates (1/2/3 a night at 7/10/14 days); damage 20 = death (game over). Starts with one genuine Immunivax and the injector guide; a scalper sells Immunivax on day%7==6 at a markup that grows each day.
perks.strategy: A hard weekly purchase that also forces the player to tell genuine from fake injectors. Cash floor must always cover one injector.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Short Sleeper
perks.effect: An after-hours outing no longer costs one normal customer the next day.
perks.strategy: Makes nightly scavenging or commissary trips free in customers. Worth ~1 customer a night for a nightly scavenger.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Side Street
perks.effect: −1 normal customer every day.
perks.strategy: Costs ~15-20 % of base traffic; production runs selling through window and suppliers feel it least.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Sycophant
perks.effect: Upper Levels +15 at start (raw); UL rep gains ×1.25; UL customer budgets +10 %.
perks.strategy: One trade from UL Tips (+15 % on UL sales). With Well Connected UL starts at 30 (Tips plus +4 UL client chance).
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Tapehead
perks.effect: The cassette player starts with all 7 standard cassettes (shabby) instead of 4 degraded ones.
perks.strategy: Cosmetic for music, but the tapes are luxury items worth up to 150 base each: possible cash and discerning-shopper bait if sold or shown (sellability unverified).
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Tinkerer
perks.effect: Item upgrades keep their material 20 % of the time.
perks.strategy: A 20 % discount on upgrade materials; only matters to runs that upgrade lots of gear.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Unlucky
perks.effect: Luck −15: no luck saves, and 15 % of scavenging searches come back empty.
perks.strategy: Small for shop runs (1 point back); bad for contraband runs (no saves) and scavengers.
perks.visible: perk VISIBLE; luck value HIDDEN

perks.name: Vending Machine
perks.effect: Vending machine installed from day 1 (the 1200 upgrade, marked unlocked).
perks.strategy: An after-hours sales engine (~70/night of cheap food) for 2 points; pays back fastest of any perk. Stock must be honest (mislabelled/stolen = crime).
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Welfare Program
perks.effect: Commissary and stamps available from day 1; on day 1 and every day%7==1 a genuine food stamp worth 160/160/120/80/40 if adjusted wealth (cash + (stock estimate − cash)/3) ≤ 600/1200/1800/2400/3000, nothing above.
perks.strategy: ≈ 160 a week of stamps early; fades as you get rich. A cash-poor start's lifeline.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Well Connected
perks.effect: +15 rep with every faction at start (raw).
perks.strategy: Puts every faction within one or two trades of its 20 perk (LL Referral, UL Tips, SEC Surplus, BM Broker, REV Request). Best stacked with a faction-specific offset to cross 20/40/60 on day 1.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: On Wild's Bad Side
perks.effect: Wild's network upgrades ×1.1, insurance ×1.5.
perks.strategy: A tax on growth; ~+10 % on every engine purchase. Low impact for runs that buy few upgrades.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Wild's Favorite
perks.effect: Wild's network upgrades ×0.9, insurance ×0.5.
perks.strategy: −10 % on every engine purchase; multiplies with LL Pillar (×0.85) and difficulty.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Working Pipes
perks.effect: Gutterflow and Rustwater taps unlocked from day 1: unlimited rust water.
perks.strategy: Starts the water engine without the 600 of taps; also free water for crops, wine and fish.
perks.visible: name+description in calendar Status; numbers in the description

perks.name: Referral
perks.effect: +1 normal customer every day (the 100 % roll always hits).

perks.name: Rare Goods

perks.visible: VISIBLE: reputation panel lists it with threshold/200 and unlocked state

perks.effect: 4 % a morning to learn a future market event 2-3 days ahead; Lower Levels operations become visible.
